"""Port of tool authorization and governance."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable


@runtime_checkable
class IToolAuthzPort(Protocol):
    """Authorization of governed tools."""

    def authorize(
        self,
        surface: Optional[str],
        tool: str,
        *,
        tenant_write_granted: bool = False,
        human_signature: Any = None,
        turn_id: Optional[str] = None,
        arguments: Any = None,
        schema_rules: Any = None,
        tool_spec: Optional[dict] = None
    ) -> str:
        """Return the authorized scope or raise (fail closed)."""
        ...
